app.title: AnyRemote
app.tagline: Enter a target address to auto-detect available remote protocols

desc.ssh: Secure Shell: run commands and transfer files (SFTP) remotely
desc.vnc: Remote desktop: view and control the target machine's GUI
desc.rdp: Windows Remote Desktop Protocol (not supported yet, planned)
desc.telnet: Legacy plaintext remote terminal (not supported yet, planned)
desc.ftp: Legacy plaintext file transfer (not supported yet, planned)
desc.smb: Windows file sharing protocol (not supported yet, planned)
